```plato
    //==
    // Numbering the undirected edges.
    //
    // An undirected edge is a twin pair, named by its lower corner. Numbering
    // edges by the rank of that corner among all such "canonical" corners gives
    // a dense edge numbering derived entirely from the packing — which is what
    // the ambo operator needs to place one new vertex per edge.

    // True when this corner names its undirected edge: the lower half of a twin
    // pair, or a boundary corner, which has no twin to share the naming with.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Typed indices - -1 means none.
    IsCanonicalCorner(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): Boolean
    {
        var twin = self.TwinCorner(corner);
        return twin.IsNone.Or(corner.Value < twin.Value);
    }
```
